I'm a qualified debt adviser and rule number one is NEVER consolidate. Until you have tackled the root cause of your uncontrolled debt, you have no chance of getting it under control. First, create a household budget, keep a money diary for at least a month to identify where you are spending unnecessarily, identify areas of your household spending that can be reduced or cancelled altogether and stick to it. Cut up ALL credit cards, open a basic bank account (no overdraft facility) with a bank where you have no debt (otherwise they can and will use their Right of Set Off), get your salary or benefits paid to the new account and start to learn to live within your means. Setting money aside every month for annual costs like MOT and servicing of your car gets you into the habit of saving. StepChange or CAB can help, so seek help to get you back on track. It's not as easy as this woman makes out but it CAN be done if you're determined.
